messages:
leo: Heads-up: customer reported onboarding hang where SDK's initial auth never finishes on Android 11-13 release builds (debug works). Sample-app repro attached.
anya: sounds like a ProGuard/R8 issue where a class used by the authenticator is stripped. any stack traces?
leo: minimal log: 
```
W/OkHttp: call canceled: java.io.IOException: canceled
E/Auth: token refresh failed: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.redwood.sdk.auth.InternalTokenState
E/Main: onboarding flow timed out after 30s
```
jack: ClassNotFound on InternalTokenState = our internal holder that is referenced reflectively by the synchronized helper. We should have a keep rule but apparently our proguard file didn't cover it for the android-sample build.
anya: That explains why auth helper falls back to launching fresh refreshes in parallel (no mutex) and the app hits connection limits -> canceled calls.
leo: Repro steps attached: build release variant with minifyEnabled true, run sample on Pixel 6 emulator, start onboarding with flaky network.
jack: Quick fixes: (1) add explicit -keep class com.redwood.sdk.auth.** { *; } to proguard consumer rules, (2) defensive runtime: if reflective helper fails, fall back to an AtomicReference-based locker (non-reflective) so we don't spin.
anya: Also add a unit test that runs with R8_minified artifact using jar of minified SDK. CI should include one smoke job that pulls the minified AAR into sample-app and runs emulator test.
jack: Patch idea (pseudo):
```
// fallback locker
private val refreshLocker = AtomicReference<Deferred<String>?>(null)
fun lockAndRefresh(): Deferred<String> {
  val cur = refreshLocker.get()
  if (cur != null) return cur
  val newFuture = GlobalScope.async { doRefresh() }
  if (!refreshLocker.compareAndSet(null, newFuture)) return refreshLocker.get()!!
  return newFuture
}
```
leo: opened PR w/ proguard rule + runtime fallback + CI matrix change (android-minified-smoke). tagging @qa-bot to schedule the job.
qa-bot: Job scheduled: android-minified-smoke #121 (pixel-6:api-31 release-minified). ETA ~15m.
anya: After merge, we should update docs: "Packaging notes for Android SDKs: required consumer ProGuard rules" and add a short blurb in onboarding troubleshooting.
leo: Agreed. Also will backport the defensive runtime fix to 0.13.x since enterprise customers using minified builds hit this.
jack: thanks 8578; will add CHANGELOG entry under java/kotlin sdk fixes.
